title: Fleur de Lis 2 Lockoff Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Welcome to Fleur de Lis 2, ideally located on Seaside Avenue just 3 houses to the Seaside Amphitheater and one block to the beach. Fleur de Lis 2 is a recent addition to the Homeowner’s Collection.
description_expanded: Description66 SEASIDE AVENUE1 KING, 1 QUEEN, 1 SLEEPER SOFAWelcome to Fleur de Lis 2 | Prime Seaside Avenue LocationWelcome to Fleur de Lis 2, a charming Seaside, Florida cottage ideally situated on Seaside Avenue, just three homes from the iconic Seaside Amphitheater and one short block from the sugar-white sands of the Gulf. A recent addition to the Homeowner’s Collection, this beautifully maintained vacation rental offers a rare combination of walkability, outdoor living, and family-friendly comfort in the heart of Seaside.Outdoor Living & Classic Seaside CharmDesigned to embrace the coastal lifestyle, Fleur de Lis 2 features expansive porches on both levels, stretching the full length of the home. The first-floor open-air porch offers outdoor dining for six alongside a spacious lounge area—an ideal spot for morning coffee or evening wine while watching life unfold along picturesque Seaside Avenue. A large enclosed backyard with a white picket fence provides a safe and private space for children to play, while the private driveway offers convenient parking for two vehicles.Inviting First Floor Living SpacesInside, this family-friendly two-bedroom Seaside vacation home showcases pickled wood floors, updated designer furnishings, and thoughtful coastal details throughout. The recently updated kitchen, open living room, and dining area flow seamlessly together, creating a welcoming space for gathering. The living room features a mounted flat-screen TV and ample seating, while the dining area comfortably seats six. A first-floor half bath adds convenience for guests, and the rear porch provides storage for beach gear and overlooks the private backyard. Just beyond, you’ll find an outdoor shower and grilling area, perfect after a day at the beach.Comfortable Upstairs Retreats & Bonus Living SpaceUpstairs, guests will find two well-appointed bedrooms and a bonus living area. The king primary suite includes a mounted flat-screen TV, French doors opening to the screened-in front porch, and a private renovated bathroom with a double vanity and walk-in shower. The queen guest bedroom also features a large flat-screen TV and porch access. The upstairs bonus living area is ideal for movie nights, board games, or afternoon naps and includes a queen sleeper sofa, allowing the home to sleep up to nine guests comfortably.Screened Porches & Seaside ViewsThe upstairs screened-in porch, accessible from both bedrooms, is furnished with rocker seating and an additional lounge area. Overlooking the treetops and Seaside Avenue, it offers a peaceful retreat to unwind and enjoy the coastal breeze.Your Perfect Seaside Family EscapeWith its prime Seaside Avenue location, generous outdoor spaces, and walk-to-everything convenience, Fleur de Lis 2 is the perfect home base for a memorable Seaside, Florida vacation. Whether you’re relaxing on the porches, exploring the town center, or heading to the beach, this cottage delivers classic Seaside charm and modern comfort in one exceptional setting.Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. Not available during peak season. 3-night minimum Spring | 5-night minimum Summer | 3-night minimum Fall | 2-night minimum WinterFEATURESPrivate Seaside residential beach at East Ruskin Pavilion176 yards or a 3-minute walk to beach accessAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts (court fees apply), 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedParking passes are limited to 1 pass for one-bedroom cottages and 2 passes for two-bedroom and larger homes. A golf cart is considered a carGolf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners visiting Seaside. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets allowed
